headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals made a statement with a 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, led by Alec Burleson's three home runs and six RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3, with Spencer Horwitz contributing three RBIs on one hit. The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers 10-5, while the Washington Nationals fell short in Philadelphia.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Sean Sullivan, a left-handed pitcher for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 5, 2026. The Chicago Cubs have transferred Ben Brown to the 60-day injured list due to a neck strain. Other notable injuries include JoJo Romero (Milwaukee Brewers), Dalton Rushing (Los Angeles Dodgers), Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), Mitch Keller (Pittsburgh Pirates), and Connor Seabold (Kansas City Royals).

The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. Johnson joins the Athletics in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have made several roster moves, trading RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 3-6 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, with Derek Hill leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Blast Past Yankees 13-7**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson hit three home runs and drove in six runs, including a key homer that scored JJ Wetherholt.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Victory Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close game, winning 4-3. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on 1 hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers in a 5-10 victory, handing the Dodgers their loss. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Sullivan Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to July 5, 2026. This move comes as a result of an ongoing injury issue.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. Johnson joins the Athletics in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas.
